name: io.climbcast/climbcast
title: ClimbCast
description: Conditions, trip briefs, alerts, permits, roads, hourly, areas, accuracy for WA, OR, BC. No account.

tools.name: get_access_and_permits
tools.description: Returns the permit entry and road access shown on a route's forecast page for a covered objective: the permit status, fee, notes and official link, and the road conditions for the approach passes, with highway, temperature, restrictions, the road agency named and the time its data was fetched. Road fetches and verified WSDOT reports at least 30 minutes old are marked stale. WSDOT reportFreshness distinguishes unknown from current; stale:false alone does not establish a current report. Informational only.

slug.description: Public objective slug returned by search_objectives.

route_id.description: Route identifier returned by search_objectives. The permit entry resolves at route level.

tools.name: get_alerts
tools.description: Returns the NPS park alerts and National Weather Service fire weather alerts displayed for a covered objective, with source attribution and retrieval timestamps. ClimbCast does not carry current USDA Forest Service alerts or closures. Informational only.

slug.description: Public objective slug returned by search_objectives.

tools.name: get_forecast_accuracy
tools.description: Returns stored public regional forecast accuracy, including observed-station or model-proxy truth lineage, data sufficiency, and eligibility. Takes either a region_id or an objective slug, which resolves to the accuracy region of the NWAC zone the objective is bound to. Informational only.

region_id.description: Public accuracy region identifier, for example pnw-olympics. Provide exactly one of region_id and slug.

slug.description: Public objective slug returned by search_objectives. It resolves to the accuracy region of the NWAC zone the objective is bound to. Provide exactly one of slug and region_id.

tools.name: get_hourly_conditions
tools.description: Returns the two-hourly temperature, wind speed, and wind direction shown in the hourly view of the forecast page's weather by elevation grid, for one day in the free forecast window, with local times, ISO timestamps, the time zone, and the chosen elevation. Takes a date from the route's visible days and an optional elevation band of base, mid, or summit. Informational only.

slug.description: Public objective slug returned by search_objectives.

date.description: Day to return, as YYYY-MM-DD, from the days in the free forecast window.

activity.description: Optional activity mode for the route forecast. Accepted values are the route's activities entries from search_objectives. When omitted, the route's default visible activity is used.

elevation_band.description: Optional elevation band for the hourly temperature and wind: base, mid, or summit. The forecast page opens on summit, which is the default.

tools.name: get_objective_conditions
tools.description: Returns public conditions for a covered objective: summit weather, the objective page's route list with grade, type, and round-trip distance, source provenance, and timestamps, in JSON or markdown. Covers up to five days. Daylight and air quality appear for the first day only, and get_trip_brief carries the per-day values the forecast page shows. Informational only.

slug.description: Public objective slug returned by search_objectives.

format.description: Text representation; structured data is included in either format.

tools.name: get_route_conditions
tools.description: Returns up to five days of public route conditions, anchored to the route high point, with catalog gain, source provenance, and timestamps. An optional activity input selects one of the route's activities listed by search_objectives. Days can carry the avalanche center, bulletin state and forecast link, forecast uncertainty, the corn harvest window, and rock conditions where the forecast page shows them for the activity, and the document carries the route's permit entry and trailhead road access. With the markdown format, these sections appear in structuredContent only. For what the whole trip looks like, get_trip_brief returns the forecast page sections in one call. Informational only.

slug.description: Public objective slug returned by search_objectives.

activity.description: Optional activity mode for the route forecast. Accepted values are the route's activities entries from search_objectives. When omitted, the route's default visible activity is used.

format.description: Text representation; structured data is included in either format.

tools.name: get_trip_brief
tools.description: Returns the signed-out forecast page sections for a route in one call, covering up to five days, or one day with the date input: forecast days, daylight, air quality, and agency alerts, each with source provenance and a freshness status. Forecast days can carry the avalanche center, bulletin state and forecast link, forecast uncertainty, the corn harvest window, and rock conditions where the forecast page shows them, and the document carries the route's permit entry and trailhead road access. Informational only.

slug.description: Public objective slug returned by search_objectives.

activity.description: Optional activity mode for the route forecast. Accepted values are the route's activities entries from search_objectives. When omitted, the route's default visible activity is used.

date.description: Optional day to return, as YYYY-MM-DD. Must be one of the days in the free forecast window.

include.description: Optional section names to return: forecast, daylight, airQuality, alerts. When omitted, all four are returned.

tools.name: list_areas
tools.description: Lists the public coverage areas shown on the coverage directory, with each area's slug, name, state or province code, and visible activities. An area is a fixed geographic definition, not a distance from the caller. Its slug is the optional area input of search_objectives. Informational only.

tools.name: search_objectives
tools.description: Searches the public coverage catalog by name or alias, with optional region and activity filters. Coverage follows the current public scope. Region filters include WA, OR, and BC. Results list each objective's slug and route IDs with their activities, which the other tools take as inputs. An optional area input limits results to the objectives the coverage directory lists under that area. Query and area can be combined, and at least one of them is needed. A query that names an area or a reviewed place name lists that area's objectives, marked by matchedBy, after any objectives matched by name. A query that names a route, or a close spelling of an objective name that matches nothing else, returns the objectives it may mean under unconfirmedMatches, never in objectives. Informational only.

query.description: Objective name, alias, place name, area name, or route name; matching ignores case, accents and punctuation, and reads Mt and St as Mount and Saint. At least one of query and area is needed.

area.description: Optional public area slug from list_areas. Limits results to the objectives the coverage directory lists under that area. At least one of query and area is needed.

region.description: Optional state or province code or name: WA, Washington, OR, Oregon, BC, British Columbia, or B.C. Matching ignores case.
